snippet.title: Froggy Brews: Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
Froggy Brews is a gentle narrative adventure game, where you play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood — it has changed over time, and so have you. You brew delicious tea, try to connect with unfamiliar faces, and help others heal as you rediscover your place in this world.

Join our Discord. Meet fellow fans, and be part of the community!: https://discord.gg/ARaHjzgGjF
Stay connected with us for more updates!: https://linktr.ee/komodorange
